audit.whatIsWrong: matchup-lint still reported MISGENDER / COPY_PASTE_BLEED / COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT / DISPLAY_ARTIFACT on karma after the proposal pass; the original edits for these fields were rejected by the 10% length-drift rule, so the defects survived on disk.
audit.why: Pronouns come from champ-data/champ-gender.js; bleed bullets promise one thing in the title and paste the generic trade line in the body; a cooldowns field with no digit carries no information. Replacement cooldowns and interactions are taken from champ-data/_kits/karma.json and champ-data/_kits/karma.json.
audit.corrected: The same corrections re-cut to fit inside the length-drift budget so that they actually apply.

edits.before: Convert before the curve flips: plates, roams, river picks with W roots. Every minute past your spike is a minute rented from his.
edits.after: Convert before the curve flips: plates, roams, river picks with W roots. Every minute past your spike is a minute rented from hers.

edits.before: Best wave: a Q-thinned slow push you RQ-crash on roam timers — your E speeds the whole team's rotations, not just yours. Worst wave: a frozen wave at his tower post-two-items — your kill window died there and the lane just hasn't noticed yet. Crash timing: every crash should buy something — a reset, a plate, a roam. Autopilot shoving buys ganks.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — the RQ chunk cycles every 30 seconds. Chip him below half and hold the kill window.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing — the RQ chunk cycles every 30 seconds. Chip her below half and hold the kill window.

edits.before: Commit on Focused Resolve (Tether)’s cooldown, on your Blackfire Torch spike, and with your jungler’s setup. His answer goes first; yours goes last.
edits.after: Commit on Focused Resolve's flat 12-second cooldown, on your Blackfire Torch spike, and with your jungler's setup. Her answer goes first; yours goes last.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve (Tether): matchup-defining — The root tether — break it with range or line of sight. It governs your forward steps. - RE shield-speed spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Focused Resolve: a flat 12s at every rank — break the tether with range or line of sight and the second hit never roots. - Inner Flame goes 9s to 5s by rank 5. - Mantra is 40s, and every ability she lands on you cuts it further.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, and on real windows RQ-W: the chunk plus tether-root turns a poke trade into a kill setup — E out before the answer.
edits.after: Inspire gives her an 800-range shield and move speed — walk with her while the 675 tether ticks and the root still lands on time.

edits.before: Spending Mantra on wave-clear while behind on poke — Karma without RQ banked is a support who took mid's farm.
edits.after: Her Inspire is 10s at rank 1 and 8s at rank 5 — chasing a sped-up Karma just walks you out of your own tether range.

notes: QA lint-repair pass. Every after-string was length-checked against the on-disk before (<10% drift) and screened for elo tiers, non-interactions and filler before being written. Spell-shield, cleanse, QSS and tenacity behaviour is absent from the kit files (needsResearch is empty by design) and is asserted nowhere here.
